points.why: It says the team stopped being able to do the work without the tool and that relying on it has faded the review skill, which is the capability-erosion dynamic in substance.
It says a second vendor fixes only vendor dependency, leaves the staff gap in place, and lets people stay unable to reconcile manually.
It recommends quarterly manual reconciliations by each person that also check the AI's output, but never says to track whether people can still do the work.
It implicitly keeps the tool and suggests quantifying the outage exposure, but never says to put the dependency on the risk register by name.

pitfalls.why: The answer keeps the tool and builds a fallback around it.
It explicitly says a backup vendor is not the first fix and puts it after the capability work.
